result.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
result.summary: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MIPA，将合成图像视为可学习原型，用冻结编码器按特征相似度把真实样本分配给原型，并通过最大化同一图像不同增强视图间分配结果的互信息、同时抑制样本集中于少数原型的平凡解，实现自监督设定下的数据集蒸馏。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以互信息目标维持增强不变信息、显式避免分配坍缩的做法，可供核查是否可作为 latent 推理中状态信息保留与信息坍缩抑制的训练目标线索；但该工作属数据蒸馏，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或证据获取。
